raise_OverrideParseException: raise an OverrideParseException with an override string and error message for config parsing failures
raise_MissingConfigException: raise a MissingConfigException with the missing config file path and available options
catch_HydraException: catch HydraException as a base class to handle all Hydra-related errors in a single block
raise_ConfigCompositionException: raise a ConfigCompositionException when config composition fails during Hydra runtime
raise_HydraDeprecationError: raise a HydraDeprecationError to signal use of a deprecated Hydra feature or API
